arms.base: Run the frozen harness against unmodified RVL c7e646b. Required reproduction: all group advantages, loss, gradients, and pre-clip grad norm are zero; optimizer default weight_decay=0.01; parameter output matches the analytic AdamW decay formula to 1e-7 maximum error; at least one parameter changes.
arms.candidate: Add finite nonnegative HFTTrainerConfig.weight_decay with default 0.0 and pass it explicitly to AdamW. Constant-reward default run must preserve every parameter exactly and have zero gradient. Explicit weight_decay=0.01 must reproduce the analytic decay formula. Mixed rewards must still give finite nonzero gradients and change parameters.

candidate.change: Expose HFTTrainerConfig.weight_decay, default it to 0.0, validate finite/nonnegative values, and pass it explicitly into torch.optim.AdamW.

claim_limits: Tiny random GPT-2 fixture only; no pretrained-model task-success claim.
This confirms an optimizer side effect at zero policy gradient; whether the intended default should regularize is an API/design question. The proposed fix makes it explicit and configurable.
Does not establish a TRL defect or general RLVR capability effect.
failure_criteria: Any base reproduction mismatch, any candidate no-signal default drift, explicit-decay formula mismatch >1e-7, or mixed-reward control fails. No training/model benchmark variants.

fixture.group: four generations with the same prompt_id

hypothesis: HFTTrainerConfig omits weight_decay, so torch.optim.AdamW supplies 0.01 implicitly. With zero gradients, AdamW still applies decoupled shrinkage θ←(1−lr·wd)θ. A configurable zero default should make the default no-signal update an identity while retaining explicit regularization and mixed-reward learning.
novelty_boundary: A narrow trainer-correctness finding in the pinned RVL implementation, not a new RL method, model-capability result, or claim about TRL.
primary_metrics: maximum absolute error against analytic AdamW decay-only formula
max next-token distribution KL from before to after
research_question: Does pinned RVL HFCausalLMGRPOTrainer mutate policy parameters when every member of a complete GRPO group receives the same reward and therefore every group-relative advantage and policy gradient is exactly zero?
